questions: When the board is fully in view, are there exactly three pens on it (no missing pen and no empty gap)?
Do all three pens point the same direction, with none flipped or reversed relative to the other two?
Are all three pens the same color as each other, with none differing in color?
Is every pen complete and capped, with none showing a bare/exposed writing tip or looking clearly shorter than the others?
Does the board move smoothly and continuously from left to right, without stopping, freezing, pausing, reversing, or jamming at any point?

question_answers.evidence: The white board is completely empty as it passes through the center of the frame; no pens are visible.
There are no pens on the board to evaluate orientation.
There are no pens on the board to evaluate color.
There are no pens on the board to check for caps.
The board moves smoothly and continuously from left to right without stopping or jamming.

parsed.reason: The board is empty and carries zero pens, which violates the nominal condition of carrying exactly three pens.

description: A pen is missing; fewer than three pens on the board.
